pack.name: food_labels
pack.title: Food label claims
pack.status_note: Rules load and match through the same engine. Connecting the agent needs a claim prompt for food labels and a labelled set to check it against.

note: Second rule pack, to show the engine is not tied to one rulebook. Summaries are plain-English paraphrases, not legal text. Clause numbers marked TODO are to be filled from the official FSSAI regulations before any real use.

FSSAI_CLAIMS2018.title: Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018

FSSAI_ORGANIC2017.title: Food Safety and Standards (Organic Foods) Regulations, 2017

rules.name: Organic needs certification and the Jaivik Bharat mark
rules.summary: Food sold as organic must be certified under a recognised system (NPOP or PGS-India) and carry the Jaivik Bharat logo on the label.

required_evidence.desc: NPOP or PGS-India certificate, or the Jaivik Bharat logo on the pack

rules.name: Words like natural, fresh and pure have conditions
rules.summary: Natural, fresh, pure, original, traditional, authentic, genuine and real may be used only when the food meets the conditions set for each word; otherwise the label must qualify or drop the word.

required_evidence.desc: Ingredient list and processing note that meet the word's condition

rules.name: Nutrition claims need the nutrient amounts to back them
rules.summary: Claims such as high protein, low fat, sugar free or source of fibre must meet the set thresholds, shown in the nutrition information on the label.

required_evidence.desc: Nutrition information table with amounts per 100 g or 100 ml

rules.name: Health claims need scientific substantiation
rules.summary: Claims that a food helps a body function or reduces a disease risk must be backed by generally accepted scientific evidence; disease-risk claims need prior approval.

required_evidence.desc: Published studies or an approval reference for the claim
